details: Analysis of this package version produced no a static rule matches and no traced behavioral findings. The scanned files contain no evidence of installer-side attack mechanisms: no lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote code, no credential or environment-variable exfiltration, no hardcoded attacker-controlled network destinations, no wallet or browser secret store enumeration, no shell-history or messaging-session harvesting, and no dependency-chain dropper structure. Without concrete behavioral or structural evidence tying the package to a supply-chain attack shape, there is no basis to classify this version as malicious under an installer-harm threat model.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
